summary: A calendar heatmap with 2026 and 2025 buttons that swap the dataset and date range.
use: Letting users compare activity across years in the same calendar view.
spec: Two `<Button` elements with `size="sm"` labelled 2026 and 2025, `variant={year === 2026 ? 'filled' : 'glass'}` and `variant={year === 2025 ? 'filled' : 'glass'}`
